dynamicEndpoints.purpose: MVP-only account records using ordinary Hollow CRUD. Includes a salted PBKDF2 password hash, never plaintext. If this collection is publicly readable, account email/profile data and password hashes may be exposed; use test accounts and unique passwords only. Not production authentication.

fields.name: string required
fields.email: email required; lowercase; app checks duplicate before insert
fields.passwordSalt: base64 string required for MVP sign-in
fields.passwordHash: base64 PBKDF2-SHA256 hash required for MVP sign-in

dynamicEndpoints.purpose: Student academic profile only; never include passwords or tokens.

Matches the existing Student Plug/ClearWords-style sync adapter. This collection is not private unless the endpoint is protected; do not sync sensitive profile details or use it for production private records without access control.
Practice history; each row should include userId, courseId, topicId, score, total, answers, createdAt.
Public course Q&A. Validate length and moderate submissions.
Student-submitted links; treat URLs as untrusted and review before promotion.

important: The Student Plug MVP intentionally uses ordinary Hollow CRUD for account records as requested. This is a prototype convenience, not secure production authentication. Public CRUD cannot guarantee private profiles, protect password hashes from being read, or prevent users from editing/deleting records. Use test data and unique test passwords only.

mvpAccountFlow.signup: POST /users after checking email duplicates with GET /users?email=...; browser derives a salted PBKDF2-SHA256 hash and stores only salt/hash, never plaintext password.
mvpAccountFlow.signin: GET /users?email=... then compare derived password hash locally.
mvpAccountFlow.session: Opaque local browser session marker only; it is not verified by Hollow and is not secure authentication.
mvpAccountFlow.warning: For MVP testing only. Public CRUD cannot protect user records or verify identity server-side. Do not use real/reused passwords or sensitive personal data.
